info.title: MonSTAR API
info.description: MonSTAR backend API for Monash University unit reviews and SETU data

tags.name: SETU
tags.description: Student Evaluation of Teaching and Units data

get.summary: Get all units from the database
Get a unit by unit code

post.summary: Create a new unit and add it to the database
Create multiple units based on input JSON data

delete.summary: Delete a unit from the database

get.summary: Get all units that have the specified unit as a prerequisite
Get all reviews from the database with an optional filter
Get all reviews for a unit from the database
Get all reviews by a specific user from the database

post.summary: Create a review for a specific unit

put.summary: Update a review by MongoDB ID (e.g. Title, Grade Obtained, Ratings)

delete.summary: Delete a review by MongoDB ID (also removes the review from the Unit\'s reviews array)

patch.summary: Toggle the likes or dislikes field for a specific review by its ID

post.summary: Send an email corresponding to a user\'s report on a review
Login and/or register a user using Google OAuth
Refresh access token using refresh token

get.summary: Get all users from the database

delete.summary: Delete a user from the database (Only admins or the user themselves can delete accounts)

post.summary: Clear the token cookies and invalidate refresh token in database

put.summary: Update user\'s username and/or password (Only admins or the user themselves can update account details)

get.summary: Check if the user has the access_token in their cookies to keep session

post.summary: Upload the given avatar to cloudinary and assign it as user\'s profileImg

get.summary: Get all notifications for a user from the database
Fetch contributors from the MonSTAR GitHub repository (If repository is private or API unavailable, returns fallback contributor data)
Get all SETU data with optional pagination
Get all SETU data for a specific unit code
Get the average scores across all SETU evaluations for a unit
Get SETU data for a specific academic season (e.g. 2019_S1)

post.summary: Create a new SETU data entry in the database (Admin access required)
Create multiple SETU entries from a JSON array (Admin access required)

put.summary: Update a SETU entry by ID (Admin access required)

delete.summary: Delete a SETU entry by ID (Admin access required)

post.summary: Admin-only endpoint to rebuild AI overviews across all units with human reviews
Admin-only endpoint to rebuild the AI overview for a single unit
